provenance.author: Bernat Espigulé
provenance.description: Six finite numerical parameter samples from the equal-contraction angular atlas.
provenance.hullScope: Finite convex hulls; their containment test is weaker than exact contact.
provenance.densityScope: Finite empirical raster density; no density of the limiting measure is asserted.
provenance.topologyScope: Atlas hue encodes a selected finite pair-address code, not a topological equivalence class.
provenance.imageProjection: Toroidal display of parameter coordinates; its central hole is imposed by the display.

differenceDensity.reference_definition: Maximum of the six per-pin 99.5th percentiles over positive physical density pixels; shared by every displayed pin.
differenceDensity.note: This nonlinear contrast is a display choice; the stored probability density is untransformed.

K.hullScope: Convex hull of unrounded finite centres; exact-arithmetic Hausdorff bound to the filled limiting convex hull. Numerical floating-point construction.

D.hullScope: Convex hull of unrounded finite centres; exact-arithmetic Hausdorff bound to the filled limiting convex hull. Numerical floating-point construction.

density.reference_definition: Maximum of the six per-pin 99.5th percentiles over positive physical density pixels; shared by every displayed pin.
density.note: This nonlinear contrast is a display choice; the stored probability density is untransformed.
density.definition: Histogram of independent uniform choices of length-22 addressed centres; original word multiplicities are retained.
